view: Front detail-dominant crop, camera slightly above collar level angled gently down; collar worn closed with the stand button fastened (no tie), matching the tech-pack pose; the downward angle looks into the neckline so the inner (neck-facing) face of the collar stand arcs across the back of the neck and dominates the upper frame; front placket visible below.

geometry.collar_type: Two-piece turned-down point collar sewn onto a separate collar stand (band).
geometry.bias_component: INNER face of the collar stand only. In the tech pack the red 45-degree diagonal hatching fills exactly the inner stand band visible inside the neckline; nothing else is hatched.
geometry.grain_map: Inner stand face: stripes at 45 degrees to the stand's long lower (neck-seam) edge. Outer stand face, top collar leaves, under collar as visible, placket, fronts and yoke: straight grain — vertical stripes on body and placket, stripes running square along the collar.
geometry.stitching: Single edge topstitch row 5 mm inside the collar leaf edges and along both long edges of the stand (drawn as dashed lines); neck seam joins stand to body.
geometry.placket: Standard sewn button placket, about 3.5 cm wide, with TWO parallel vertical topstitch rows and a visible placket button on a vertical buttonhole; the stand carries a horizontal buttonhole fastened over the stand button (collar closed).
geometry.buttons: Exactly 2 buttons visible in the blueprint crop: 1 stand button (fastened, collar closed) and 1 placket button below.

ratios: Stand height (3.5 cm) is about three and a half shirt-button diameters (10 mm buttons).
Collar point length is about twice the stand height (7.5 cm vs 3.5 cm).
About ten to twelve stripes span the stand height (3 mm stripe repeat across a 3.5 cm band).
Bias stripes meet the neck seam at exactly 45 degrees — precisely halfway between vertical and horizontal; edge topstitch sits at one-seventh of the stand height from each edge.
locked_features: Fine blue-and-white bengal/candy stripe shirting is mandatory — on solid white the bias cut is invisible.
ONLY the inner collar-stand face shows diagonal (45-degree) stripes; every other visible panel shows straight-grain stripes.
Red hatching in the tech pack is a bias-direction marker: render as real diagonal stripe grain, never as red color, red lines, or printed hatching.
Two-piece collar: point collar leaves on a separate stand; collar worn closed with the stand button fastened, camera angled slightly down into the neckline to reveal the inner band, exactly as drawn.
Edge topstitching 5 mm from collar and stand edges; placket carries two parallel vertical topstitch rows and a visible button.
No annotation text, arrows, numerals, or drawing marks may appear in the photograph.
distinguishing_vs_siblings: bias-none: no diagonal stripes anywhere, all panels straight grain. bias-inner-top-collar: diagonal grain sits on the UNDERSIDE OF THE COLLAR LEAF (blueprint hatches the raised under-collar area above the band), not the stand. bias-inner-cuff: diagonal grain sits on the INNER FACE OF THE BARREL CUFF (blueprint hatches the inside of a turned-open rounded cuff). This option is the only one where the diagonal stripes live on the neckband's inner face inside the neckline.
uncertain: Stand height is not dimensioned in the tech pack; standard 3.5 cm assumed (the 5.0 cm tall-band variant exists as a separate option csh-50, so default height is used here).
Stripe scale is not specified by the tech pack; ~3 mm bengal/candy stripe chosen per category rule.
Blueprint crop shows 2 placket-line buttons total; final photo crop may include only the upper placket button depending on framing.
